latest_release.body:
## Changelog
### Bug Fixes
* 06d15297eedff4690d88cce541941267ae598863: fix(authz): log denials at warn level with request context (#6675) (@erka)
* 1c1660cc4fd0dbe62f128e2e499318ca7ddef5ac: fix: security fixes for v2.14.1 (#6679) (@markphelps)
### Other
* 9d8c33de4326858240c7eb6abe092be251f20841: chore(deps): bump github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azidentity (#6684) (@dependabot[bot])
* 32b0cefc448f4f322de57be61db40fdef633a115: chore(deps): bump github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 (#6682) (@dependabot[bot])
* e734e73e06c2ac546b8594a32bf3bca98fe36491: chore(deps): bump the go-minor-patch group across 1 directory with 6 updates (#6685) (@dependabot[bot])
* 33c9959d88a0ce8d5653edd3909917a7bc1aa80b: chore(deps): bump the grpc group across 1 directory with 3 updates (#6681) (@dependabot[bot])
* ac6f26b26c2a11eae72add8c1eeb6e90831822a3: chore(deps): bump the npm-minor-patch group across 1 directory with 6 updates (#6686) (@dependabot[bot])
* 3f7fc18925cfe0aa18a37fba68bfe9dae1d6a161: chore(deps): bump the react group in /ui with 2 updates (#6683) (@dependabot[bot])
* 3f59af5a2755d17c4e65b9a341d0c184135621fa: chore: release v2.14.1 (@markphelps)

## Installation
### Docker Images :whale:
```bash
  docker pull docker.flipt.io/flipt/flipt:v2.14.1
```
```bash
  docker pull ghcr.io/flipt-io/flipt:v2.14.1
```
